title: Middle Eastern Pistachio Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Middle Eastern-inspired stir fry dish loaded with crunchy pistachios and wholesome ingredients. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch option.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in the Middle Eastern seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked brown rice and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios on top of the rice mixture.
